     3	def BFS(transition_dict, target_state, initial="INITIAL"):
     4	    """
     5	    transition_dict: { (state, input) : next_state }
     6	    target_state: state we want to reach
     7	
     8	    Returns: list of inputs (commands), or None if unreachable
     9	    """
    10	    queue = deque()
    11	    queue.append((initial, []))   # (current_state, input_sequence)
    12	    visited = set([initial])
    13	
    14	    while queue:
    15	        state, seq = queue.popleft()
    16	
    17	        if state == target_state:
    18	            return seq
    19	
    20	        for (s, inp), next_state in transition_dict.items():
    21	            if s == state and next_state not in visited:
    22	                visited.add(next_state)
    23	                queue.append((next_state, seq + [inp]))
    24	
    25	    return None

     5	    def __init__(self):

    15	    def add_node(self, model):
    16	        if model in self.model_to_node:
    17	            return
    18	        self.model_to_node[model] = self.nodes
    19	        self.node_to_model[self.nodes] = model
    20	        self.nodes += 1

    23	    def add_edge(self, model1, model2):

    25	            self.add_node(model1)
    26	        if model2 not in self.model_to_node:
    27	            self.add_node(model2)
    28	            
    29	        self.graph[self.model_to_node[model1]].append(self.model_to_node[model2])
    30	        self.dependencies[self.model_to_node[model2]].append(self.model_to_node[model1])

    38	    def CallEdge(self, model, dependency_models: List):

    53	    def topologicalSortUtil(self, v, visited, sorted_order):

    55	        
    56	        for i in self.graph[v]:
